# SbarHive

> A free, open source file converter for Linux and Windows. Select files, right click, pick a cell in a hexagonal hive; the result is saved next to the original. Everything runs on your machine: no uploads, no telemetry. First beta 0.4.0-beta.1.

- [Formats](https://m7mmad-omar.github.io/sbarhive/en/docs/formats.md)
- [Shortcuts](https://m7mmad-omar.github.io/sbarhive/en/docs/shortcuts.md)

## Project

- [Download](https://m7mmad-omar.github.io/sbarhive/en/download/): Linux DEB and RPM, Windows MSI and ZIP, with SHA256SUMS steps
- [Windows and SmartScreen](https://m7mmad-omar.github.io/sbarhive/en/windows/): the Windows build is unsigned
- [Privacy](https://m7mmad-omar.github.io/sbarhive/en/privacy/): no tracking, signed updates only
- [Releases](https://m7mmad-omar.github.io/sbarhive/en/releases.md)
- [Source](https://github.com/M7MMAD-OMAR/sbarhive): GPL-3.0-or-later
